_meta.marathi_status: Workbook A.2 score sheet and §3.3–3.6 tables only translate column headers and group titles to Marathi; per-checkpoint Marathi is not present in source. All text_mr / evidence_mr fields use the spec-mandated [REVIEW] {English} placeholder pending Sagar's translation pass.
rules_applied: A.2 score sheet wording used as source of truth; §3.3–3.6 narrative wording recorded in translator_notes.
weight = 1 for Operations + Reporting/Service; weight = 2 for Cash + Inventory (per Workbook Day 3 table and Spec §6.5).
critical = true for CW.* and IW.* (per Spec §1.3 / Workbook §1.3 — Cash and Inventory are double-weighted critical SOPs).
photo_required_on_fail = true for all CW.* and IW.* per Spec §4.4 requires_photo_on_fail rule (mandatory photo on Cash/Inventory Fails).

allows_na default false. Flipped true only where the spec implies non-applicability: CW.6 (GST output/input — not all weeks have both directions, e.g. zero-purchase week), CW.7 (cumulative variance on a partial week), CW.8 (no refunds in week makes refund-rate undefined), RS.5 (no complaints opened in week makes closure-rate undefined), RS.6 (no NPS responses in a week makes trend undefined), IW.4 (no service intake in week), IW.5 (no returns in week), IW.7 (no high-value 60+ aging items in week), IW.8 (no write-offs in week), IW.9 (no debit notes in week), IW.11 (fortnightly cadence — NA on alternate weeks).
CW.7 cumulative weekly cash variance threshold ±₹200 per Spec §6.7 (echoed in A.2). Distinct from CW.3-narrative petty-cash ±₹100/week. CW.7 evidence notes the ±₹200 rule explicitly.
